title: A Ledger for the Parish
author: S. M. Sterling
blurb: Ines Underhill, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
